en: This ancient suit last saw service at the peak of Hab Spire Venictus during the quelling of the Fortune Insurrection. As the towering city burned, the corrupt governor was cast down from a towering height. The Inquisition sealed the upper levels for a hundred years while servitors incanted endless rituals of purification.
zh_new: 這套古老裝甲最後一次服役，是在鎮壓財富叛亂時，位於維尼克圖斯居住尖塔頂端。高聳城市燃燒之際，腐敗總督從塔頂被拋下。審判庭封鎖上層區域一百年，期間機僕不斷吟誦無盡淨化儀式。
